how_derived: On paper. Six strong candidates (estimate 0.80 at price 0.40) are each sized at the 5% cap of an equity of 1000000 = 50000 (the portfolio limit of 30% is reached exactly, not exceeded). Their six markets resolve against them at t=20..25. The breaker halts when (peak - equity)/peak >= 20%.

S05-C7.why: t=30, a strong signal, the breaker is halted

S05-C8.why: t=35, after four refused re-arm requests: still halted

S05-C9.why: t=37, after the re-arm at t=36. Equity 700000; six losses put the throttle at its maximum level 4: 5% x (3/4)^4 x 700000 = 0.05 x 81/256 x 700000 = 11074.2 -> 11074; payout floor(11074000000/410000) = 27009. Re-arming does not restore the size.

halt_why: fourth loss: (1000000 - 800000)/1000000 = 20% exactly; the comparison is 'greater or equal'. The HALT row is the row right after that settlement.
rearm_refused_why: t=31 no record at all; t=32 a record that declares an agent; t=33 a human record that names another halt; t=34 a file that does not exist
ledger_rows_why: 1 genesis + 9 candidates + 9 decisions + 8 settlements + 1 HALT + 4 REARM_REFUSED + 1 REARM
